steps.title: Read free team
preconditions: A local Worker, isolated synthetic identities, team, sessions and restricted in-process provider fixture are in use.
Synthetic owner is a member of a free team with a synthetic customer.

expectations.description: HTTP 200 reports free plan and status and exposes billing-customer flag to owner.

steps.title: Reject member billing

Synthetic member belongs to the free team.

expectations.description: Member portal request returns 403 not_allowed before any provider request.

mappings.why: The billing route rejects a member at the owner role guard before a provider call; the rate limit on the same line and Durable Object checkout and portal routes are not reached. Synthetic local HTTP journey, restricted provider fixture; static association, not measured execution or live Stripe acceptance.

The active event was already recorded; the provider fixture is changed to canceled before replay.

expectations.description: Duplicate event returns 200 without another provider request.

mappings.why: The duplicate event is looked up in the serialized coordinator; the observed replay does not request the changed provider snapshot. Synthetic local HTTP journey, restricted provider fixture; static association, not measured execution or live Stripe acceptance.

The existing receipt belongs to the same team in this replay; cross-team event reuse rejection is not tested. Synthetic local HTTP journey, restricted provider fixture; static association, not measured execution or live Stripe acceptance.
